title: Approved Limit on a FlexLine Increase Request
content:
**Clause — FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit.** The approved limit is the current credit limit plus the tier's maximum increase percent of it, rounded down to the next 100.00 USD, never above the limit requested or the tier's maximum limit.

**Limit requested.** The limit requested is the requested limit of the line's latest increase request awaiting decision (of two on the same date, the one recorded first), or the current credit limit when there is none.

**Order.** The increase is added to the current credit limit and the sum is rounded down to the next 100.00 USD; it is then held to no more than the limit requested and the tier's maximum limit. The approved limit is never below the current credit limit. Every rounding to the cent takes an exact half cent to the even cent.

The tier's maximum increase percent and maximum limit are the line's tier figures; the current credit limit is the one on Larkspur's record of the line on the decision date.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs, FlexLine Plus: 30%, maximum limit 10000 USD)

| Current limit | Increase | Sum, rounded down to 100 | Limit requested | Approved limit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 6000.00 | 1800.00 | 7800.00 | 8200.00 | 7800.00 |
| 6050.00 | 1815.00 | 7800.00 | 9100.00 | 7800.00 |
| 6000.00 | 1800.00 | 7800.00 | 7000.00 | 7000.00 |
| 9000.00 | 2700.00 | 11700.00 | 12000.00 | 10000.00 (tier maximum) |
